title: Certainty in the Time of Doubts
description: A path to accompany your adolescent (13-15) in building unwavering yaqeen amidst doubts: welcoming religious questions, proofs of iman, ikhlas, and the inner muraqabah of Allah—an aqeedah with conviction, not mere taqlid.

primary_reference.info: ثلاثة الأصول والقواعد الأربع لابن عثيمين، العقيدة الطحاوية، أسئلة الأطفال الإيمانية، أصول الإيمان على فهم السلف

review_defects.english: A path to accompany your adolescent
review_defects.why: The Arabic says the path itself accompanies the adolescent (مسار يرافق), but the English translation changes the subject to an implied 'you', making it a path for the parent to accompany the adolescent. This alters the agency and the program's role.
